approach: Write the Fahrenheit reading as 1.9 times the Celsius reading, and solve it together with the standard Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion.

steps.text: Write the condition that the Fahrenheit reading is 90% more than the Celsius reading.
Write the standard conversion between the two scales.
Set the two expressions for F equal and solve for C.
Use F = 1.9C to get the Fahrenheit reading.

common_mistakes.text: Solving correctly for C = 320 and then stopping there, reporting this Celsius value as if it were the Fahrenheit answer.
